title: Rapid outbound surge — afternoon sprint
content:
Context: afternoon 2-hour surge after account reviews. Goal = 12 dials, 6 meaningful convos, 2 qualified next-steps. Focus on mid‑market finance + retail verticals; prioritize accounts with recent inbound activity or product signals (trial usage, embedding calls).

Priority buckets (90m):
- Hot (today/this week): schedule demos, qualify budget/decision-maker. High reply velocity.
- Warm (2 weeks): need nurturing + targeted case studies.
- Cold (long-term): quick value hooks, leave voicemails, add to nurture cadence.

Call cadence & timeboxing:
- 14:00–14:30: Hot list (3 top accounts) — deep prep notes + call.
- 14:30–15:00: Cold outreach blitz (8 quick dials) — short script, leave 1-line voicemail.
- 15:00–15:30: Follow-ups (emails + SMS for prospects I spoke with this week).
- 15:30–16:00: Admin (log touches, update Salesforce, set next steps).

Today's manual call list (name / role / company / why now / quick note / desired next step):
1) Priya Kapoor — Head of ML Engineering — DataWave Finance — trial usage spiked 3/10, 3 seats active, using embeddings for search. Note: concerned about PII. Script: ask about PII redaction/KMS. Next: 30-min technical sync with Solutions Eng (cc: Mira). Priority: Hot.
2) Daniel Ruiz — CTO — Loom Retail — submitted pricing request on 3/13; competitor eval. Note: cares about latency/cost per token. Script: quick benchmark ask + offer 15-min cost/latency analysis. Next: book demo w/ latency comparison. Priority: Hot.
3) Sarah Ng — Product Lead — CampusEd — demo 2 weeks ago, no reply to follow-up. Note: procurement window in April. Script: short check-in, share tailored benchmark + customer snippet. Next: soft commit for Q2 evaluation. Priority: Warm.
4) Marco Silva — VP Eng — NetKit — cold lead from list. Note: small infra budget. Script: leave voicemail focusing on 2-min ROI. Next: add to 4-week nurture. Priority: Cold.
5) Tien Ho — Head of Platform — FincoX — inbound from webinar; sent whitepaper. Note: security questions outstanding. Script: ask one clarifying Q about KMS/HSM requirement. Next: schedule compliance call w/ security SME. Priority: Warm.

Quick scripts / snippets (copy/paste friendly):
- Cold voicemail (10–15s): "Hi <name>, Jayden from Redwood Inference — we help teams cut inference cost while keeping latency tight. Call me at 415‑555‑0192 to save time on your model serving — cheers."
- Opening line for warm inbound: "Hey <name>, saw your trial spike — curious what you're testing and if you want a short cost + latency snapshot I can run over 15 minutes."
- Two-sentence email follow-up after call: "Thanks for your time. Per our chat, I’ll send the cost/latency snapshot and a 30-min slot for a technical review. Any constraints I should know about before looping in engineering?"

Notes to self (things to add to SFDC after each touch):
- Lead status, next_step, reason_for_no — be concrete.
- Add tag: "trial-usage-2026-03" for any spike accounts.
- Attach snippet: trial metrics screenshot + funnel notes.

Open questions / playbook refinement ideas:
- Need a quick one-pager for security talking points (KMS, VPC private control plane, SOC2) that AE can email. Follow up with security team (Ethan). Jira: AI-945 tracks this.
- Template for latency-first pitch vs cost-first pitch — collect examples from 3 wins and inline them in the playbook.

Action items (post-sprint):
- Send calendar invite to Priya + Solutions Eng (Mira) — due EOD.
- Drop Loom of 2-min latency comparison for Daniel — record now if time.
- Update SFDC for all touched accounts, include a one-line summary.
- Move cold list to nurture sequence and schedule automated 4-week follow-up.

Micro-reminders (notes to self):
- Keep calls under 6 minutes unless they ask for deeper dive.
- If procurement mentioned, capture timeframe and stakeholders.
- Use "supported models" shorthand: "Hosted + Dedicated + Private options" rather than long copy when on a call.

End-of-sprint metrics to log quickly:
- Dials: __ /12
- Meaningful convos: __ /6
- Qualified next-steps: __ /2
- New trials flagged: names/emails

Scratchboard (quick phrases I liked today):
- "We help teams make inference predictable — not just faster."
- "If latency matters, we can show you a live delta with your workload in 15 minutes."

Misc links to drop in emails:
- Hosted API quickstart: https://docs.redwood.com/hosted/quickstart
- Dedicated capacity overview: https://docs.redwood.com/dedicated/overview

Random to-dos (low effort):
- Ping Mira about security one-pager.
- Create 1-line voicemail variants for APAC timezone.

End.
